name: Client benefits loyalty subscriptions offers
objective: Close loyalty, offers, membership and subscription purchase/renew/cancel/compensation as one retry-safe client journey with DSH entitlement truth and WLT financial truth.
truthOwner: DSH owns benefits/loyalty/offer/subscription business entitlement state; WLT owns payment, ledger, refund and compensation truth. Existing canonical Product Truth/PRD must decide terms; the unit cannot invent commercial policy.

tasks.objective: Converge loyalty, offers, membership and benefits projection on canonical eligibility and publication truth.
tasks.currentProblem: BenefitsHub exposes loyalty points/tier, offers/coupons, plans and membership, but the existing package had no journey owning their eligibility, publication, actor isolation or canonical readback.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace benefits payload from DSH marketing/loyalty/coupon/subscription contracts and database to the client. Prove actor scope, offer validity/publication windows, loyalty earning/reversal and membership entitlement without frontend-derived commercial truth. Resolve any missing authority through existing Product Truth/PRD rather than inventing terms.
tasks.targetState: The client sees only current eligible benefits, authoritative loyalty/membership state and valid offers; cancellation/refund/order changes converge into the same projection.
tasks.action: Start at DSH canonical marketing/loyalty owner, then generated/shared client bindings and BenefitsHub presentation.
mustNotChange: Do not calculate authoritative points/tier/discount entitlement in the frontend.
Do not expose unpublished/expired/ineligible offer as usable.
Do not invent commercial policy absent canonical authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrong actor cannot read another client's benefits.
Unpublished/expired/ineligible offers are absent or fail closed.
Loyalty earn/reversal and membership projection converge after order/refund changes.
Client values match canonical server projection.
tasks.rollback: Preserve canonical entitlement and funding ownership; never restore client-local commercial truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: Benefits/loyalty/offer entitlement projection and direct tests.

tasks.objective: Make subscription purchase, payment, activation and renewal restart-safe and exactly-once.
tasks.currentProblem: The subscription API creates a fresh idempotency key from time plus process-local sequence for every call, while the controller keeps pendingPurchase/paymentSession only in component memory. A timeout, navigation loss or app restart can lose the governed attempt identity and tempt a new purchase/renewal mutation.
tasks.requiredChange: Bind each user-intended purchase/renewal to a durable governed mutation attempt/correlation identity, recover pending purchase/payment session from authoritative DSH/WLT readback after restart, and ensure unknown payment result blocks duplicate financial mutation until reconciliation. Preserve DSH entitlement versus WLT money ownership.
tasks.targetState: One user intent creates at most one subscription purchase and one financial effect; restart/retry resumes the same authoritative attempt or returns a deterministic conflict/readback.
tasks.action: Repair attempt identity/persistence at shared client and DSH/WLT boundary, then test timeout, duplicate tap, process restart, stale session and payment unknown-result cases.
mustNotChange: Do not generate a new business attempt merely because the process restarted.
Do not mark entitlement active from client payment UI alone.
Do not move ledger/payment truth into DSH.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate tap/replay/restart cannot create a second purchase or charge.
Pending/unknown payment resumes or remains explicitly unresolved.
Renewal preserves one entitlement extension and one financial effect.
tasks.rollback: Never restore ephemeral-only attempt identity after a duplicate-effect defect is proven.
tasks.commitBoundary: Subscription attempt identity, recovery and DSH/WLT financial boundary.

tasks.objective: Close subscription cancellation and compensation without double entitlement or double refund.
tasks.currentProblem: BenefitsHub exposes cancellation and compensation status, but the old package had no owner for cancellation races, retry/restart, WLT compensation, entitlement revocation or reconciliation.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace cancel request through DSH subscription lifecycle and WLT refund/compensation evidence. Enforce legal state/version, durable idempotency, one compensation effect, explicit pending/unknown status and canonical reload after restart or provider delay.
tasks.targetState: Cancellation has one auditable DSH lifecycle transition and at most one WLT compensation; client never shows final refunded/cancelled state before authoritative evidence.
tasks.action: Red-team cancel versus payment/activation/renewal, duplicate cancel, timeout, WLT delay, restart and reconciliation mismatch.
mustNotChange: Do not convert unknown/pending into success.
Do not keep active entitlement after canonical cancellation completion unless policy explicitly requires it.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate cancel produces one operational and financial effect.
Cancel/activate/renew races resolve by legal server state/version.
Pending compensation survives reload/restart and reconciles to one final result.
Client readback matches DSH entitlement plus WLT financial evidence.
tasks.commitBoundary: Subscription cancellation/compensation lifecycle and direct tests.
